{{Top}}
[[File:Rotta_pack.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] in a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] backpack]]
A '''backpack''' was an object carried upon the back used to carry items. Using minimal technology, the backpack was widely used throughout the galaxy. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had a blue colored backpack made on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] out of [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]]-skin. It possessed many pockets, which Skywalker used while on patrol to hold supplies. Skywalker wore it on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], when he was under [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] tutelage. Yoda rode inside the backpack at least once, instructing Luke during a training run.

[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] and some [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] carried backpacks during battles in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commandos]] carried grenades and other items in backpacks. [[Clone medic/Legends|Clone trooper medics]] carried backpacks of medical equipment.

Later, Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] carried backpacks during certain operations that required them to be independent and self-sufficient for long periods of time. The standard [[Private/Legends|private]] stormtrooper backpack was equipped with an orange [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] and contained [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11]] [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]] among many other items.
